# Smoothcraft image requests, tier 3: mobs, objects and sky

696 textures. The rules in [image-requests.md](image-requests.md) apply:
Photoreal, finely detailed base-colour (albedo) map. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no baked shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights or reflections (Smoothcraft lights every surface itself). Keep the vanilla colours and overall read so the game is still recognisable. These are UV maps at 8x the vanilla size: paint over the reference from
`tools/make_references.py` and keep every region in place.
